declare
 drive_lov BOOLEAN; 
 v_date date;
begin
 --v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'); -- Commented vide IM5660
 v_date := get_local_date;
 :control_blk.no_of_staff := null;

 /** validating for a drive id **/
if (:control_blk.drive_id is not null ) then
 BEGIN
 select dr.drive_date, to_char(dr.drive_date,'Dy'), dr.drive_type,
 substr(initcap(sp.name),1,40), sp.sponsor_id
 into :control_blk.drive_date, :control_blk.day_of_week, :control_blk.drive_type,
 :control_blk.sponsor_name, :control_blk.sponsor_id
 from drives dr, drive_sponsors ds, sponsors sp 
 where dr.drive_id = :control_blk.drive_id and 
 dr.drive_type in ('I','C') and 
 dr.status = 'CNFRM' and 
 dr.drive_date > (v_date-1) and
 dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 ds.drive_id = dr.drive_id and
 sp.sponsor_id = ds.sponsor_id and
 sp.chapter_id = dr.chapter_id and
 not exists 
 (select a.drive_id 
 from staff_schedule_details a, staff_schedule_hdr b 
 where a.schedule_id = b.schedule_id 
 and a.drive_id = dr.drive_id 
 and b.status in ('FINAL', 'TENTV')) 
 and sp.sponsor_id = 
 (select sponsor_id 
 from drive_sponsors 
 where drive_id = dr.drive_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1) 
 and rownum=1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 /** drive_lov := Show_Lov('lov_drive_id'); 
 show_error('11109');
 check_package_failure;
***/
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 begin
 select sum(number_reqd) into 
 :control_blk.no_of_staff
 from drive_estimated_resources 
 where drive_id = :control_blk.drive_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 resource_code = 'STAFF';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :control_blk.no_of_staff := 0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 piggy_drive(:control_blk.drive_id);
 check_package_failure;
end if; 
end;

/*------------------------------------------------------------------
 This procedure checks whether staff is available for the drive.
 unavl_flag = 'N' => staff is available
 unavl_flag = 'Y' => staff is unavailable
--------------------------------------------------------------------*/
PROCEDURE check_unavl (p_staff_no in varchar2,p_drive_id in varchar2,p_drive_date in date, 
 unavl_flag out varchar2) IS
 act_start date ;
 act_end date ;
 unavl_from date ;
 unavl_to date ;
BEGIN
 begin
 select from_time,to_time
 into unavl_from,unavl_to
 from staff_off_day
 where staff_no = p_staff_no
 and unavail_date = p_drive_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then unavl_flag := 'N' ; return ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 if unavl_from is null or unavl_to is null then /*-- Staff is unavailable whole day --*/
 unavl_flag := 'Y' ;
 return ;
 end if ;
 calc_drive_sch_times(p_drive_id,act_start,act_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 if (act_start >= unavl_to) or (act_end <= unavl_from) then
 unavl_flag := 'N' ; 
 else
 unavl_flag := 'Y' ;
 end if ;
END;

diff_time number := 0;
tot_time number := 0;

 FROM staff_off_day

 FOR C1_rec IN C1

 st_time := c1_rec.from_time;
 ed_time := c1_rec.to_time;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 tot_time := round( (tot_time + diff_time),3);
 END LOOP ;

--message('Total time--for staff'||:unassign_staff.staff_no||'---'||tot_time);pause;
 IF tot_time between 1 and 1339 THEN
 begin

 AND :pre_assignments.actual_eod
 or :pre_assignments.actual_bod between from_time 
 AND to_time-(1/(60*60*24))
 or :pre_assignments.actual_eod-(1/(60*60*24)) between from_time 
 AND to_time
 )
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 begin
 ok_nok := 'Y' ;
 FOR C2_rec IN C2
 LOOP
 ok_nok := 'N' ;
 END LOOP;
 IF ok_nok = 'N' THEN

 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, 'Staff is unavailable due to '||off_reason);
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);
 END IF;
 end;
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 ELSIF tot_time = 1440 THEN
 al_id := find_alert('WARN_ALERT');
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, 'Staff is unavailable due to '||off_reason);
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);
 ok_nok := 'N' ;
 ELSIF tot_time = 0 AND full_off = 'Y' THEN

 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, 'Staff is unavailable for full day due to '||off_reason);
